text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Producer is an amazing person.
She never hesitates to take action,
and she's always so professional!
choice_data_list: She's kind once in a while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
プロデューサーってすごい人だよね。
常に迷わずテキパキしてて、
まさに敏腕って感じ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't really deny that...
But I think it's because she has a strong sense of self.
I hope I can become that strong one day. Huh? You don't think I should?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひ、
否定はできないけど……
でもそれも、
自分をしっかり持ってるからなんだよね。
あんな風に強い人になれるかな……
え？　
やめた方がいい？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, isn't she?! This one time, a fan started a fight, right?
But she calmed him down in no time, all on her own.
At that moment, Producer was so dependable... But also very violent.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよねっ！　
前にファンのお客さんがけんかを始めちゃったとき、
たった一人であっという間に落ち着かせちゃったの。
あのときの
プロデューサー、
すごく頼もしかったな……
一番暴れてたけど。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Hee hee. Once in a while, right?
She's easy to misunderstand, but she's a really nice person.
She motivates us with her harsh words!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ。
たまに、
なんだね。
誤解されやすいけど、
プロデューサーは優しいんだよ？
厳しい言葉で、
私たちを奮い立たせてくれるんだから！
